artist.name: Alex Sampson
artist.short_description: Alex Sampson — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring romantic pop.
artist.biography: Alex Sampson is a Canadian pop singer-songwriter who built an early audience by publishing covers and original performances online. Music-service biographies describe his transition from social-media exposure into a broader recording career, including the 2024 EPs Blurry Vision and Hopeless Romantic. He also reached the semifinals of America's Got Talent in 2024. Songs such as ‘Pretty Baby’ and ‘Play Pretend’ place romantic longing and earnest declarations at the center of his catalogue. In 2026, he expanded his writing with the eight-song Growing Pains project. In a direct interview, Sampson described the title song as unusually personal, including an audio recording of himself with his mother when he was young. He has also spoken about how personal relationships and observations shape his songwriting. At Afterglow, he bridges intimate acoustic-style ballad writing and bigger, more dramatic pop arrangements. This assessment of his style is editorial. Each individual song story should distinguish his documented explanations from listeners’ possible interpretations.

career_milestones.description: Reached America’s Got Talent semifinals and released Hopeless Romantic.
